rows.requirement: Standby continuous rating at 0.8 PF shall meet the scheduled capacity of 1000 kW and 1250 kVA.
Electrical output shall be 480Y/277 volt, 3-phase, 4-wire, 60 Hz.
Motor starting capability shall be not less than 1500 kVA with a maximum voltage dip of 30% for the 1000 kW unit.
Excitation power to the automatic voltage regulator shall be provided by a permanent magnet generator (PMG) or equal.
Diesel engine configuration shall be 8, 12, or 16 cylinder, 4 cycle, turbocharged/aftercooled or naturally aspirated.
Governor shall be electronic speed-sensing capable of isochronous frequency regulation from no load to full rated load.
Starting system shall be remote 24 volt DC electric starter.
Average fuel consumption at full standby load shall not exceed 75 gph for the scheduled 1000 kW set
Cooling system shall be unit mounted radiator cooled and maintain safe operation at 122°F maximum ambient temperature
Generator set engine shall comply with applicable EPA Tier levels for non-road engines
Operate at ambient conditions of 300 ft altitude and ambient temperature range of 10 to 122°F
Engine speed shall not exceed 1800 rpm
Generator shall be 4-pole, brushless, and two-thirds pitch wound
Generator insulation shall be NEMA Class F or better
Provide a 120 V, single-phase space heater to prevent condensation in the generator.
Provide 3-pole generator output circuit breaker(s) equipped with solid-state trip units.
Voltage regulation shall be within plus/minus 2% from no load to rated load.
Total harmonic distortion of voltage waveform from no load to full linear load shall not exceed 5% of rated voltage.
Provide a UL 2085 listed in-skid diesel fuel tank with usable capacity for not less than 24 hours of operation at full standby load.
Provide two 5000 W, 480 V single-phase jacket-water heaters.
Provide a weatherproof and rodent-proof outdoor enclosure to enclose the generator set with silencers installed inside.

follow_ups.subject: Project Alpha GEN-M - submittal review comments (12 items)
follow_ups.body:
Hello,

We have reviewed your submittal (spmi-1mw-uls-data-sheet) against the project specification. Please respond to each item below.

1. Motor starting capability shall be not less than 1500 kVA with a maximum voltage dip of 30% for the 1000 kW unit. (spec 2.1.C.1)
   Specification: 26-32-13-engine-generators-alpha p.3, 2.1.C.1: "and 1500 kVA (1000 kW sets) for motor starting with a maximum voltage dip of 30%"
   Request: The submittal is not clear on this point. Please confirm exactly what will be supplied for this project.

2. Average fuel consumption at full standby load shall not exceed 75 gph for the scheduled 1000 kW set (spec 2.1.D.1 (Diesel Fuel System))
   Specification: 26-32-13-engine-generators-alpha p.4, 2.1.D.1 (Diesel Fuel System): "Average fuel consumption at full standby load shall not exceed 145 gph for 2000 kW sets and 75 gph for 1000 kW sets."
   Your submittal: spmi-1mw-uls-data-sheet p.2: "75.1 (284)"
   Request: The submittal does not meet this requirement. Please confirm a compliant alternative, or submit a formal deviation request with the reason and any cost or schedule impact.

3. Operate at ambient conditions of 300 ft altitude and ambient temperature range of 10 to 122°F (spec 2.1.E.1)
   Specification: 26-32-13-engine-generators-alpha p.4, 2.1.E.1: "Ambient conditions of 300' altitude and an ambient temperature of 10 to 122°F."
   Your submittal: spmi-1mw-uls-data-sheet p.3: "3% per 1000 ft. above 3000 ft."
   Request: The submittal is not clear on this point. Please confirm exactly what will be supplied for this project.

4. Generator shall be 4-pole, brushless, and two-thirds pitch wound (spec 2.1.G (Generator))
   Specification: 26-32-13-engine-generators-alpha p.5, 2.1.G (Generator): "Generator shall be 4-pole, revolving field type, brushless, dynamically balanced, skewed laminated, two thirds pitch wound"
   Your submittal: spmi-1mw-uls-data-sheet p.2: "4 Pole"
   Request: The submittal is not clear on this point. Please confirm exactly what will be supplied for this project.

5. Generator insulation shall be NEMA Class F or better (spec 2.1.G.1)
   Specification: 26-32-13-engine-generators-alpha p.5, 2.1.G.1: "NEMA Class F or better insulation as defined by NEMA MG1.65."
   Request: The submittal is not clear on this point. Please confirm exactly what will be supplied for this project.

6. Provide a 120 V, single-phase space heater to prevent condensation in the generator. (spec 2.1.G.5)
   Specification: 26-32-13-engine-generators-alpha p.5, 2.1.G.5: "A 120 volt, single phase space heater shall be provided to prevent condensation in the generator."
   Request: The submittal is not clear on this point. Please confirm exactly what will be supplied for this project.

7. Provide 3-pole generator output circuit breaker(s) equipped with solid-state trip units. (spec 2.1.H (Generator Output Circuit Breaker(s)))
   Specification: 26-32-13-engine-generators-alpha p.5, 2.1.H (Generator Output Circuit Breaker(s)): "Generator set shall have 3 pole output circuit breaker(s) with solid state trip units as shown on the drawings."
   Your submittal: spmi-1mw-uls-data-sheet p.2: "Solid State, HZ/Volts"
   Request: The submittal is not clear on this point. Please confirm exactly what will be supplied for this project.

8. Voltage regulation shall be within plus/minus 2% from no load to rated load. (spec 2.1.I.2 (Voltage Regulation))
   Specification: 26-32-13-engine-generators-alpha p.6, 2.1.I.2 (Voltage Regulation): "Voltage Regulation: Plus 2% no load to rated load; rheostat for _5% voltage adjustment."
   Your submittal: spmi-1mw-uls-data-sheet p.2: "½%, No load to full load"
   Request: The submittal is not clear on this point. Please confirm exactly what will be supplied for this project.

9. Total harmonic distortion of voltage waveform from no load to full linear load shall not exceed 5% of rated voltage. (spec 2.1.I.4 (Total Harmonic Distortion (THD)))
   Specification: 26-32-13-engine-generators-alpha p.6, 2.1.I.4 (Total Harmonic Distortion (THD)): "The sum of ac voltage waveform harmonies, from no load to full linear load shall not exceed 5% of the rated voltage"
   Your submittal: spmi-1mw-uls-data-sheet p.2: "Max 3½%"
   Request: The submittal is not clear on this point. Please confirm exactly what will be supplied for this project.

10. Provide a UL 2085 listed in-skid diesel fuel tank with usable capacity for not less than 24 hours of operation at full standby load. (spec 2.1.K.1 (In Skid Diesel Fuel Tank))
   Specification: 26-32-13-engine-generators-alpha p.9, 2.1.K.1 (In Skid Diesel Fuel Tank): "Each generator set shall be provided with a UL 2085 listed manufacturer's standard in skid fuel transfer day tank. The tank shall have usable capacity for not l"
   Request: The submittal is not clear on this point. Please confirm exactly what will be supplied for this project.

11. Provide two 5000 W, 480 V single-phase jacket-water heaters. (spec 2.1.K.2 (Jacket-Water Heater))
   Specification: 26-32-13-engine-generators-alpha p.8, 2.1.K.2 (Jacket-Water Heater): "The engine shall have two KIM #Hotstart (480 volt, 1-phase) or approved equal, 5000W jacket-water heaters supplied from a "normal" branch circuit."
   Request: The submittal is not clear on this point. Please confirm exactly what will be supplied for this project.

12. Provide a weatherproof and rodent-proof outdoor enclosure to enclose the generator set with silencers installed inside. (spec 2.1.K.9 (Generator Outdoor Housing))
   Specification: 26-32-13-engine-generators-alpha p.10, 2.1.K.9 (Generator Outdoor Housing): "Provide a weatherproof and rodent-proof outdoor shelter to entirely enclose each generator set, including batteries. Silencers shall be installed inside enclosu"
   Request: The submittal is not clear on this point. Please confirm exactly what will be supplied for this project.

Thank you.
Procurement, Project Alpha
